# MentorWise AI

> AI-powered career arsenal for students and freshers — 12 specialist AI agents for resumes, interviews, internships, exams and growth, free to use. Built in Chennai, India.

MentorWise AI is an EdTech platform that gives students access to MNC-grade career tooling through a free ecosystem of specialist AI agents.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the MentorWise AI ecosystem and core agents.
- [Agent Ecosystem](/agents): All 12 specialist AI agents plus upcoming programs.
- [About](/about): Mission, pillars and vision behind MentorWise AI.
- [Founders](/founders): Profiles of Mohammed Faizal M and Saif Ahmed Z.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the team via form, email, WhatsApp or LinkedIn.
